mapper.select:
SELECT tpd.*, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, fp.FINPROD_ABBR, fpt.TYPE_6, fpt.TYPE_7 secondType,
fpt.TYPE_9 type9, fpt.TYPE_10 type10, fpt.TYPE_11 type11
FROM (
SELECT T1.TRADE_ID, #{VALID_STATUS_01} VALID_STATUS, T1.FINPROD_TYPE2, T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.PS, T1.TRADE_MARKET, T1.TRADE_PLAT, T1.TRADE_MARKET_MODE,T1.TRADE_AMT, T1.PRIN_AMT,T1.SHARE_AMT, T1.CCY, T1.TRADE_DATE, T1.SETTLE_DATE, T1.REMARK,T1.WORKFLOW_ID, null WORKFLOW_STATUS,T1.B_TRADE_ID,T2.ENTRUST_ID,T2.PORTFOLIO_ID,pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID,pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME
,tpda.ASSET_RECOMMAND_ORG
FROM (SELECT * FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL MINUS SELECT W1.* FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL W1 INNER JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL W2 ON W1.B_TRADE_ID = W2.TRADE_ID WHERE W1.PS = #{PS24}) T1 left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD tpda on T1.TRADE_ID =tpda.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T2 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = T2.PORTFOLIO_ID
(T1.IS_CANCEL is null or T1.IS_CANCEL = #{YES_NO_NO}) and T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADESTATUS_NEW} AND T1.PS != 'T62' AND T1.PS != 'T63' AND T1.PS != 'T64'
UNION ALL
SELECT T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID TRADE_ID, #{VALID_STATUS_01} VALID_STATUS, T1.FINPROD_TYPE2, T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.PS, T1.TRADE_MARKET, T1.TRADE_PLAT, T1.TRADE_MARKET_MODE,T1.TRADE_AMT, T1.PRIN_AMT,T1.SHARE_AMT, T1.CCY, T1.TRADE_DATE, T1.SETTLE_DATE, T1.REMARK, null WORKFLOW_ID, null WORKFLOW_STATUS,T1.B_TRADE_ID,T2.ENTRUST_ID,pp.PORTFOLIO_ID,pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID,pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME ,T2.ASSET_RECOMMAND_ORG FROM WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD T2 on T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T2.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID
(T1.IS_CANCEL is null or T1.IS_CANCEL = #{YES_NO_NO}) and T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADESTATUS_NEW} AND (T1.PS = 'T65' OR T1.PS = 'T66')
UNION ALL SELECT T1.TRADE_ID, #{VALID_STATUS_02} VALID_STATUS, T1.FINPROD_TYPE2, T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.PS, T1.TRADE_MARKET, T1.TRADE_PLAT, T1.TRADE_MARKET_MODE,T1.TRADE_AMT, T1.PRIN_AMT,T1.SHARE_AMT, T1.CCY, T1.TRADE_DATE, T1.SETTLE_DATE, T1.REMARK, null WORKFLOW_ID, null WORKFLOW_STATUS,T1.B_TRADE_ID,T2.ENTRUST_ID,pp.PORTFOLIO_ID,pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID,pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME
,tpda.ASSET_RECOMMAND_ORG
FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD tpda on T1.TRADE_ID=tpda.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T2 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON T1.TRADE_ID = PT.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID
PP.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y' AND (T1.IS_CANCEL is null or T1.IS_CANCEL = #{YES_NO_NO}) and T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADESTATUS_NEW} AND T1.PS != 'T62' AND T1.PS != 'T63' AND T1.PS != 'T64'
UNION ALL
SELECT T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID TRADE_ID, #{VALID_STATUS_02} VALID_STATUS, T1.FINPROD_TYPE2, T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.PS, T1.TRADE_MARKET, T1.TRADE_PLAT, T1.TRADE_MARKET_MODE,T1.TRADE_AMT, T1.PRIN_AMT,T1.SHARE_AMT, T1.CCY, T1.TRADE_DATE, T1.SETTLE_DATE, T1.REMARK, null WORKFLOW_ID, null WORKFLOW_STATUS,T1.B_TRADE_ID,T2.ENTRUST_ID,pp.PORTFOLIO_ID,pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID,pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME ,T2.ASSET_RECOMMAND_ORG FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD T2 on T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T2.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID
(T1.IS_CANCEL is null or T1.IS_CANCEL = #{YES_NO_NO}) and T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADESTATUS_NEW} AND (T1.PS = 'T65' OR T1.PS = 'T66')
UNION ALL SELECT T1.TRADE_ID, #{VALID_STATUS_03} VALID_STATUS, T1.FINPROD_TYPE2, T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.PS, T1.TRADE_MARKET, T1.TRADE_PLAT, T1.TRADE_MARKET_MODE,T1.TRADE_AMT, T1.PRIN_AMT,T1.SHARE_AMT, T1.CCY, T1.TRADE_DATE, T1.SETTLE_DATE, T1.REMARK, null WORKFLOW_ID, null WORKFLOW_STATUS,T1.B_TRADE_ID,T2.ENTRUST_ID,PP.PORTFOLIO_ID,pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID,pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME
,tpda.ASSET_RECOMMAND_ORG
FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD tpda on T1.TRADE_ID=tpda.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T2 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON T1.TRADE_ID = PT.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID
PP.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y' AND T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADESTATUS_REVOKE} AND T1.PS != 'T62' AND T1.PS != 'T63' AND T1.PS != 'T64'
UNION ALL
SELECT T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID TRADE_ID, #{VALID_STATUS_03} VALID_STATUS, T1.FINPROD_TYPE2, T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.PS, T1.TRADE_MARKET, T1.TRADE_PLAT, T1.TRADE_MARKET_MODE,T1.TRADE_AMT, T1.PRIN_AMT,T1.SHARE_AMT, T1.CCY, T1.TRADE_DATE, T1.SETTLE_DATE, T1.REMARK, null WORKFLOW_ID, null WORKFLOW_STATUS,T1.B_TRADE_ID,T2.ENTRUST_ID,pp.PORTFOLIO_ID,pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID,pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME ,T2.ASSET_RECOMMAND_ORG FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD T2 on T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T2.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID
T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADESTATUS_REVOKE} AND (T1.PS = 'T65' OR T1.PS = 'T66')
) tpd
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON fp.FINPROD_ID = tpd.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON fpt.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD T3 ON fp.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID
tpd.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{COMMON_BUSINESS_TYPE_TRD02}
AND (TPD.PORTFOLIO_ID IN (#{item} ) OR TPD.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID IN (#{item}))
AND tpd.ENTRUST_ID like concat_ws('',#{entrustId}, '%')
AND (tpd.PORTFOLIO_ID in (select PORTFOLIO_ID from PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY where USER_ID = #{loginUser}) OR tpd.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID in (select PORTFOLIO_ID from PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY where USER_ID = #{loginUser}))
AND fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat_ws('',#{finprodId}, '%')
AND tpd.TRADE_MARKET = #{tradeMarket}
AND fpt.TYPE_6 = #{type6}
AND fpt.TYPE_9 IN
#{item,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND fpt.TYPE_10 IN
#{item,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND fpt.TYPE_11 IN
#{item,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND tpd.PS in
#{item}
AND tpd.TRADE_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{tradeDateBegin}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND tpd.TRADE_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{tradeDateEnd}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND fpt.TYPE_7 =#{secondType}
AND (tpd.VALID_STATUS NOT IN (#{VALID_STATUS_02}, #{VALID_STATUS_03}) OR tpd.PS NOT IN (#{PS24},#{PST19},#{PST05}) OR T3.TRM_FUND_TYPE IS NULL OR T3.TRM_FUND_TYPE != #{TRM_FUND_TYPE05})
ORDER BY tpd.TRADE_DATE DESC

where.if: (T1.FINPROD_ID LIKE concat_ws('','%', #{search}, '%') or T1.FINPROD_NAME LIKE concat_ws('','%', #{search}, '%'))

if.test: finprodId != null and finprodId != '' and (changeTo == null or !changeTo)

mapper.select:
SELECT T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, T1.FINPROD_NAME text, T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.FINPROD_NAME, T1.CCY, T1.CALENDAR_ID, T1.PROFIT_TYPE, DATE_FORMAT(T1.VDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') VDATE, T1.TRADE_MARKET, T1.MANAGER, T2.TYPE_6,
T2.TYPE_9, T2.TYPE_10, T2.TYPE_11,
T1.P_FINPROD_ID, DATE_FORMAT(T3.TOFF_STRDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') TOFF_STRDATE, DATE_FORMAT(T3.TOFF_ENDDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') TOFF_ENDDATE, T3.TRM_FUND_ABBR, T3.TRM_FUND_TYPE, T3.GRA_FUND_TYPE, T3.PUR_RED_ID, T3.PUR_RED_ABBR, T3.PUR_START_LOW, T3.RED_START_LOW, T3.ETF_TYPE, T3.ETF_MIN_PRUNIT,
T3.PUR_SPEED, T3.RED_SPEED FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID
AND T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID != #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT B.VALUATION FROM FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION B LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT C ON B.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AND B.FINPROD_TYPE2 = C.FINPROD_TYPE2
C.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND B.VAL_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{netDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
mapper.insert: insert into PTL_TRADE ( PORTFOLIO_ID, BUSI_NO, BUSI_TABLE, BUSI_ID, BUSI_TYPE, INV_AIM, SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, SETTLE_DATE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME ) SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID, concat_ws('',BUSI_NO , 'R') , BUSI_TABLE, BUSI_ID, BUSI_TYPE, INV_AIM, SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, SETTLE_DATE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, #{updateUser}, NOW() FROM PTL_TRADE WHERE BUSI_NO = #{tradeId}
